_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Klondike Solitaire kaji hkan sa. Nanhte a lam kaba wa, kaba hpaw shawng hpe foundation piles de du shangun na.

Kaji Gunhpawt:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Ace mare King de du shangun, hpaw shawng hte rau
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Hpaw shawng rau, kadau kadau (kadau ni, ni kadau)
- Stock: Hpaw shawng hpe waste pile de shangun
- Waste (W): Hpaw shawng kaba wa, shangun na

A Lai:
- 'draw' - Stock mare waste de hpaw shawng shangun
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Hpaw shawng kaba wa, shangun na
  Kaja: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count hpe 'all' mung, hpaw shawng kaba wa shangun na.
- 'forfeit' - Kaji hkan sa, nanhte a lam kaba wa, shi shangun na
- Pile a lam: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Nanhte a lam kaba wa, shi shangun na, kaja hkan sa.
  Kaja: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Tableau piles kaba wa, King ni shangun na.
A Lai shangun na, kaja hkan sa, shi shangun na.
'forfeit' hpe shangun na, kaji hkan sa, nanhte a lam kaba wa, shi shangun na.
